title: vs.actor-archetype
description: One MAP ZUD enemy bundle: its identity bytes and the parts a room spawn loads, named by conversion output id instead of copied (Docs/ASSET_PIPELINE.md §6.2.5, Content/ActorArchetype.hpp). The native loader also checks what a schema cannot: that each id names a current output of the right kind and that the rebuilt file fits the game's read.

display_name.description: Optional informational name, not an identity or gameplay field.

source.description: The disc file the archetype came from, e.g. MAP/Z001U00.ZUD.

source_sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the source file as extracted.

header.description: The identity bytes (MENU9.PRG ZudData): the encyclopedia preview shows them, and a room spawn shares each with the enemy's data slot. The spawn loads only the parts.

model_id.description: The SHP model id the encyclopedia previews, e.g. 79 for OBJ/4F.SHP.

blade_item_id.description: The blade's item id (combination-blade-results legacy_id), or null for none.

weapon_category.description: The weapon category the blade's battle sequence follows; bare-hands when the enemy has no blade.

shield_item_id.description: The shield's item id, e.g. 127 for a Buckler, or null for none; stored as the item id less 31.

movement_class.description: The enemy's movement class, which room placement reads (decomp field defaultMaterial).

body.description: The character model: a converted model, or a glTF of the archetype's own beside this file.

weapon.description: A converted weapon model, or null for none.

shield.description: A converted shield model, or null for none.

material.description: A material as the materials catalog names it.

id.description: A conversion output id, e.g. model.obj.0a, model.obj.01.wep or animation.obj.00_bt1.

file.description: A glTF file name in this file's directory, e.g. Z049U06.gltf.

animation.description: No bank, a converted bank, or a bank of the archetype's own as vs.actor-animation writes it.

bones.description: The bones each clip animates; a bank for another bone count is kept but the game skips it.
